items.title: EvoEmbedding: Evolvable Representations for Long-Context Retrieval and Agentic Memory
items.title_zh: EvoEmbedding：面向长上下文检索与智能体记忆的可演化表征
items.summary: Introduces EvoEmbedding, an embedding model that produces "evolvable" representations by maintaining a continuously updated latent memory as it processes inputs sequentially, targeting long-context retrieval and agentic memory where information is dynamic and order-dependent.

items.title: Dissecting Agentic RAG: A Component Ablation for Multi-Hop QA with a Local 7B Model
items.title_zh: 解构智能体RAG：面向多跳问答的本地7B模型组件消融研究
items.summary: Runs a controlled component ablation of a full agentic RAG pipeline—iterative reasoning, query decomposition, and adaptive retrieval—on 5,000 multi-hop QA questions using only a local 7B model, to test whether the added agentic complexity actually helps.

items.title: LEDGER: Scaling Agentic Document Editing with Dependency-aware Graph Retrieval
items.title_zh: LEDGER：基于依赖感知图检索的规模化智能体文档编辑
items.summary: Presents LEDGER for agentic editing of long, structured documents; it builds a lightweight dependency graph capturing hierarchy, explicit/implicit references, and semantic relations, then uses graph-guided retrieval to select only the context each edit needs without breaking cross-references.

items.title: PulseCX: Breaking the Closed-World Assumption in Real-Time CX
items.title_zh: PulseCX：打破实时客户体验中的封闭世界假设
items.summary: Proposes PulseCX for real-time customer-experience agents, decoupling knowledge acquisition from consumption; an asynchronous agent linearizes external signals into a Decay-Aware Temporal Knowledge Graph (DA-TKG) governed by reinforcement learning.

items.title: Negative Knowledge as Failure-aware Shared Memory for AutoResearch
items.title_zh: 负面知识：面向自动研究的失败感知共享记忆
items.summary: Proposes a negative-knowledge memory layer for AI research agents: a curator agent turns each failed attempt into a bounded, typed record in a shared bank that downstream agents explicitly adopt or reject; reported to outperform baselines on ScienceAgentBench retries and cross-task PDE research.

items.title: Hallucination as Context Drift: Synchronization Protocols for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 幻觉即上下文漂移：多智能体LLM系统的同步协议
items.summary: Argues that many multi-agent LLM hallucinations arise from "context drift"—divergence of agents' internal knowledge states—and introduces the Context Divergence Score (CDS), a lightweight metric quantifying knowledge-state discrepancy, together with synchronization protocols.

items.title: Counsel: A Meta-Evaluation Dataset for Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: Counsel：面向智能体任务的元评估数据集
items.summary: Introduces Counsel, a meta-evaluation dataset for agentic tasks that targets the bottleneck of judging agent trajectories, providing a basis to assess the soundness of LLM-as-a-judge critiques at both process and outcome levels.

items.title: Dissecting Agentic RAG: A Component Ablation for Multi-Hop QA with a Local 7B Model

items.title: CalVerT: Augmenting Agents with Calibrated Verifier Telemetry Improves Action and Learning in Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
items.title_zh: CalVerT：用校准验证器遥测增强知识密集型任务中的智能体
items.summary: Introduces calibrated verifier telemetry (CalVerT) to give knowledge-intensive QA agents a clearer view of whether their current answer is uncertain, unsupported, or complete, addressing failure modes of committing to unsupported answers and over-retrieving.

items.title: Training the Orchestrator: A Supervised Approach to End-to-End PDDL Planning with LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 训练编排器：面向端到端PDDL规划的监督式LLM智能体方法
items.summary: Presents HALO (Hybrid Agent-Learned Orchestrator), which trains the orchestrator in an LLM-agent PDDL planning loop via supervision instead of calling a frontier LLM at every refinement step, aiming to cut cost in verifier-checked plan repair.

items.title: Safe to Check, Unsafe to Use: Relinking at the Compression Boundary of LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 检查时安全、使用时危险：LLM智能体压缩边界处的重链接漏洞
items.summary: Identifies "relinking," a security vulnerability at the prompt-compression boundary of LLM agents: a summarization-based compressor acts as a confused deputy, combining locally benign, distributed fragments into a complete malicious instruction that pre-compression filters miss.

items.title: CRAwLeR -- Cross-Reference Aware Legal Retrieval
items.title_zh: CRAwLeR：交叉引用感知的法律检索
items.summary: Introduces CRAwLeR, a benchmark for cross-reference-aware chunk retrieval in legal documents; its pipeline detects legal cross-references and links target chunks to the context genuinely required to answer, addressing weak context-dependence in prior retrieval benchmarks.

items.title: Error-Aware TF-IDF Retrieval-Augmented Generation for ASR Error Correction
items.title_zh: 面向ASR纠错的错误感知TF-IDF检索增强生成
items.summary: Proposes a lightweight, purely lexical error-aware RAG framework for ASR error correction that accounts for phonetic misrecognitions without heavyweight cross-modal embeddings, targeting hallucinated rare entities and domain terms in low-resource languages.

items.title: TACO: Task-Aware Column Description Generation Using LLMs
items.title_zh: TACO：使用LLM生成任务感知的列描述
items.summary: TACO uses LLMs to generate task-aware column descriptions for tabular data with missing or cryptic documentation, supporting downstream tasks such as NL2SQL, table question answering, and entity linking.

items.title: When Compression Helps and When It Hurts: Condition-Aware Analysis of Chain-of-Thought Distillation
items.title_zh: 压缩何时有益、何时有害：思维链蒸馏的条件感知分析
items.summary: Provides a condition-aware analysis of Chain-of-Thought distillation, disentangling granularity, importance criteria, restructuring level, and compression budget across domains to clarify when compressing teacher reasoning traces helps versus hurts smaller student models.

items.title: Decodable but Not Faithful: Coupling Natural-Language Rationales to Programmatic Verifiers
items.title_zh: 可解码但不忠实：将自然语言推理与程序化验证器耦合
items.summary: Proposes verifier-coupled reasoning that inserts inline claims into reasoning traces and trains a consistency head to predict programmatic verifier outputs; finds a gap between decodability and faithfulness—consistency training makes verifier information decodable but not necessarily faithful.

items.title: Beyond the Next Step: Variable-Length Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
items.title_zh: 超越下一步：面向长程规划的可变长度潜在世界模型
items.summary: Introduces variable-length latent world models for long-horizon planning that move beyond one-step JEPA-style prediction, aiming to avoid the compounding error of recursively rolling out single-step latent dynamics.

items.title: When Does Overlap Help? OSU-Mem and a Cell-Conditional Analysis of Trajectory Memory for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 重叠何时有益？面向LLM智能体轨迹记忆的OSU-Mem与单元条件分析
items.summary: Introduces OSU-Mem and a cell-conditional analysis asking when organizing LLM-agent trajectory memory into overlapping semantic units (where a step may belong to several units) improves retrieval over flat or disjoint memory, rather than claiming a general-purpose memory system.

items.title: PrivacyAlign: Contextual Privacy Alignment for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: PrivacyAlign：面向LLM智能体的情境化隐私对齐
items.summary: Frames privacy as a contextual alignment problem for LLM agents—every message, post, or tool call is a judgment about what is appropriate to share, with whom, and under what conditions—and studies aligning those judgments with social norms and user intent.

items.title: Per-Entity Bias Mapping for AI Visibility: Why Brand Mentions Require Entity-Specific Calibration
items.title_zh: 面向AI可见性的按实体偏差映射：为何品牌提及需要实体特定校准
items.summary: Argues that aggregate AI-visibility metrics (mention or citation rate) are insufficient and introduces Per-Entity Bias Mapping (PEBM), a ten-dimensional framework separating raw from verified mentions and identifying failure modes such as invisibility from weak knowledge-graph presence.

items.title: Is Agent Code Less Maintainable Than Human Code?
items.title_zh: 智能体代码的可维护性是否不如人类代码？
items.summary: Presents CodeThread, a framework for building controlled experiments from repository-level histories, to investigate whether code produced by coding agents is less maintainable than human code when future agents build on top of it, and the compounding downstream effects.

items.title: EvoEmbedding: Evolvable Representations for Long-Context Retrieval and Agentic Memory
items.title_zh: EvoEmbedding：面向长上下文检索与智能体记忆的可演化表征
items.summary: Introduces EvoEmbedding, an embedding model that produces "evolvable" representations by maintaining a continuously updated latent memory as it processes inputs sequentially, targeting long-context retrieval and agentic memory where information is dynamic and order-dependent.

items.title: From Embedding Geometry to Spectral Search: Energy Dispersion Networks For Vector Retrieval
items.title_zh: 从嵌入几何到谱搜索：面向向量检索的能量弥散网络
items.summary: Proposes Graph Wiring and its task-specific instantiation Spectral Indexing, interpreting embedding spaces as spectral graphs over their feature-space topology and coupling geometric similarity with spectral information for vector search.

items.title: Aligning Sentence Embeddings to Human Concepts via Sparse Autoencoders
items.title_zh: 通过稀疏自编码器将句向量对齐到人类概念
items.summary: Uses Top-k Sparse Autoencoders to disentangle dense sentence-transformer embeddings (e.g., E5) into human-interpretable concepts, aiming to make RAG retrieval more interpretable and controllable despite feature superposition.

items.title: CuratorKIT : Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation for LLM Post-Training
items.title_zh: CuratorKIT：面向LLM后训练的数据整理与合成数据生成
items.summary: CuratorKIT is an open-source Python library covering the full LLM post-training data lifecycle—ingestion, deduplication, synthetic generation, and quality filtering—in a single configurable, auditable pipeline.

items.title: ATLAS: Agentic Taxonomy of Large-Scale Software Ecosystems
items.title_zh: ATLAS：大规模软件生态的智能体分类体系
items.summary: ATLAS automatically constructs a hierarchical taxonomy of GitHub software repositories and classifies projects end-to-end, combining LLM global knowledge with real repository distributions to address the flat, inconsistent coverage of GitHub Topics (which covers only 67% of projects).

items.title: EvidenceLens: A Claim-Evidence Matrix for Auditing Financial Question Answering
items.title_zh: EvidenceLens：用于审计金融问答的主张-证据矩阵
items.summary: EvidenceLens is a visual-analytics prototype that treats financial question answering as a claim-evidence alignment problem, decomposing answers to expose directly grounded statements, weak synthesis, and unsupported claims across text, tables, and charts.
